rationale: The stock gapped down ~11.6% on earnings and has been consolidating in the upper portion of today's range (~79th percentile), sitting just below the 9-EMA ($203.54) with price action showing choppy, low-conviction 1-minute candles and no clear directional momentum. The news catalyst (earnings beat but sell-rated with negative estimate revisions) creates ambiguous directional pressure — the gap-fill bounce from $185 low to $203 is already largely complete, making both a continuation long and a fade short risky without a cleaner setup. With 3 open long positions already and limited available buying power, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
